name: default
about: The output format the models are asked for. brief.py renders it into the brief, run_round.py maps each reply by these keys, and the review site shows the fields in this order.

v2 (2026-09-10, chosen by QC): the story and its labels only, with the outline straight after the title. v1 also asked for a premise line, the nearest existing story, why the story stands beside it, and its lasting residue. In the two rounds written under v1 those self-descriptions ran as long as the outlines, 11 of 17 outlines in 2026-09-10-r02 ended on a from-then-on residue clause, 9 of 17 measured themselves against the same accepted story, and all 17 were discarded. v1 is kept in formats/archive/default-v1.json; older rounds still display its fields, and --format archive/default-v1 can still generate with it.
To change the format, edit this file, or copy it to formats/<new-name>.json and pass --format <new-name>. No code change is needed.
Placeholders: <<PREMISE_HINT>> becomes the slot hint from brief.py (v2 has no field that uses it), <<MAX_CHARS>> becomes the outline ceiling drawn for the slot.
body_field names the field holding the outline itself. Fields that are not Candidate attributes are kept in candidate.extra.

show tells the review site where a field goes: title, kind, cast, location, nearest, body, note (listed under the outline with its label), or hidden. label_en is the English label; like label and show it is display only and never reaches the brief.
Bump version whenever the wording or the field list changes, so rounds generated under different formats can be told apart.
intro: 输出一个 JSON 对象，字段如下：
outro: 只输出这一个 JSON 对象，不要输出任何其他文字。

fields.instruction: 故事大纲，**不超过 <<MAX_CHARS>> 字**。不是正文，不要写对白和场面。
出场角色的 slug 列表。
场景文件名，从上面的场景清单里挑最合适的一个。**地点由故事决定，不要为了用某个地点而编故事。**
**只统计新的客串角色或新的场景**，两者都没有就填 `"none"`。新的情节、道具、笑点、以及关于现有角色的新事实都**不算**——那些是正常创作。
